title: A Positivity No-Go Theorem for Ultraviolet-Suppressed Brane-Cluster Gravity
description:
A Poisson brane gas yields an ultraviolet-suppressed propagator with a single graviton pole. We realize its transmission multiplier as a unitary matrix coefficient and prove that the resulting gauge-invariant curvature covariance violates reflection positivity.

Version 3 includes the manuscript, standalone amsart source, bibliography audit, and revision notes.
